histr-01-c2.text: Thucydides. History of the Peloponnesian War, Book 1, chapter 22 (English translation, Perseus Digital Library). Perseus Digital Library, Tufts University.
histr-01-c2.quote: And it is compiled rather for an everlasting possession than to be rehearsed for a prize.
histr-01-c2.claim: He offered his work as ktēma es aiei, a possession for all time.

histr-01-c1.text: James Lloyd (2012). Thucydides. World History Encyclopedia.
histr-01-c1.quote: our word for history comes from the same Greek word which means an inquiry
histr-01-c1.claim: The word history comes from the Greek historia, meaning "inquiry" or "investigation." By its very name, history claims to be a critical inquiry into the past.

histr-03-c1.claim: In 1929, Marc Bloch and Lucien Febvre founded the journal Annales d'histoire économique et sociale at Strasbourg.
